redeemMd:
## How to Redeem Oil Warfare Tycoon Codes
There are no special requirements to redeem codes in Oil Warfare Tycoon. Just follow these steps to get your rewards:
1. Launch the game by clicking [[roblox_link|Launch Oil Warfare Tycoon]].
2. Look for the Twitter button near the cash counter on the right side of the screen.
3. Click the Twitter button to open the code input window.
4. Type or paste your code carefully into the text box.
5. Press Confirm to redeem your rewards instantly.
rewardsMd:
## What Rewards You Normally Get?
Codes in Oil Warfare Tycoon mainly grant you valuable in-game items and boosts that directly impact your gameplay. Here’s what you can expect:

| Reward Type          | Description                                                                                  |
|---------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Skins               | Unique cosmetic appearances like Neon Nightfall, Verdant, and Magmaflow to customize your look. |
| In-Game Cash        | Large sums of money ($100,000 to $1,000,000) to invest in upgrades, weapons, and vehicles.   |
| Medals              | Special currency used for unlocking exclusive items or upgrades.                             |
| Elite Camo Cases    | Loot boxes that contain rare camo skins or gear enhancing your arsenal.                      |
| Research Unlocks    | Instant unlocks for research upgrades speeding up your tech progress.                        |
| Cash Boosts         | Timed multipliers (2x cash) that increase your earnings for a set period.                    |
| Weapons             | Exclusive guns like the Explosive Sniper, Barrett M82, and FAL Heavy to strengthen your attacks. |

These rewards help you build a stronger base and dominate other players more effectively.
troubleshootMd:
## Why Codes Might Not Work
Codes might fail if you enter them incorrectly or if they have expired. Always copy the code exactly as shown, including capitalization and symbols. If you’re sure the code is correct but it still doesn’t work, it might be expired or temporarily disabled by the developers.
